lines: Years passed. Ismail, alayhis salaam, grew into a boy who could walk and work beside his father.
Then Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, saw a dream. And his son understood it as a command from Allah.
He said: "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I sacrifice you. So see what you think."
And the son answered: "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
When they had both submitted, and Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, laid him down on his forehead...
Allah called to him: O Ibrahim, you have fulfilled the vision. And Allah says: indeed, this was the clear trial.
"And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice."
Every Eid al-Adha, Muslims remember this moment: a father and a son who both submitted to Allah.
